title: Exact Optimization References for Industrial Wireless Uplinks: Reproducibility Archive

creators.name: Alabdullah, Mohammed
creators.affiliation: Iran University of Science and Technology, Computer Networks Engineering, Tehran, Iran

description: Reproducibility archive for the journal extension on exact optimisation references for joint radio-resource allocation in industrial wireless uplinks. It contains the exact fixed-demand radio-allocation solver, the continuous-power mathematical lower reference, the offline finite-horizon exact references on aged and current beam gain (noncausal, non-deployable diagnostic references), the frozen confirmatory campaign (400 execution units, 2,400 result rows, paired seeds 50002–50021), the final analysis and descriptive extraction, a deterministic generator for Figures 1–3, the final table records, exactness and numerical-tolerance tests, and integrity records (canonical raw-tree digest v1 5b31e54dbe6c6a2b897768ee100cadb0248cedf8edc50497cf5dea7bf935852b). The conference artifact on the main branch is unchanged.
